# Keep symbol upload in release-promotion dependencies

Entry 709 adds upload-symbols to the beetmover-repackage kind dependencies. The accepted kind still includes it and uses shipping-phase promote. The commit message states that this makes symbol upload part of promotion. Preserve this dependency when changing the promotion graph. No graph evaluation or upload ran; source alone does not prove every symbol artifact was uploaded.

Scope: taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-repackage.
